# SummitPrecisionDesign

## Summit Precision Design
Source: https://derekverbrugge.github.io/SummitPrecisionDesign/

Clarity built
for the climb.
Purposeful landing pages and digital experiences
that make what you do easier to understand—and easier to act on.
Explore services
How I think
THE OBJECTIVE
Good design makes the important
things easier to understand.
Businesses rarely suffer from a lack of information.
More often, the important information is buried beneath
complexity.
PHILOSOPHY
Understand honestly.
Distill clearly.
Recommend with integrity.
Understand honestly.
Start with reality. Understand the customer,
the business, the environment, the objective,
and the constraints before deciding what should
be built.
Distill clearly.
Look beyond symptoms to find the essential problem.
Remove unnecessary complexity and give the important
information the attention it deserves.
Recommend with integrity.
Build what actually fits. Explain the reasoning,
tradeoffs, and limitations honestly.
WHAT I BUILD
Digital experiences
with a clear purpose.
From a single landing page to a complete digital
presence, every element begins with the objective.
Landing Pages
Landing pages designed to make a specific offer easier
to understand, trust, and act on.
Conversion-focused structure
Clear messaging
Responsive design
Fast, lightweight implementation
Digital Marketing
Marketing experiences built around the questions customers
need answered before they can make a decision.
Campaign strategy
Value proposition development
Content hierarchy
Customer-focused messaging
Web Development
Thoughtful implementation that uses technology where it
meaningfully improves capability, performance,
accessibility, or experience.
HTML, CSS & JavaScript
Responsive interfaces
Static websites
Performance-minded development
THE METHOD
Complexity belongs
underneath.
The customer shouldn't have to understand
everything that went into the solution.
Research, strategy, design, development,
analytics, typography, interaction, and
technical implementation can be sophisticated.
The experience should not be.
Good technology disappears into usefulness.
Good design disappears into understanding.
THE APPROACH
A landing page should behave
like a good salesperson.
Connect
Earn attention without shouting.
Understand
Show the visitor that you understand
their situation.
Clarify
Reduce the problem to what actually matters.
Demonstrate
Show how the solution addresses the problem.
Prove
Support important claims with evidence.
Invite
Make the next decision simple.
The goal isn't to manufacture desire.
It is to understand existing needs and determine
whether the solution can genuinely fulfill them.
THE STANDARD
Precise enough
to be useful.
Every decision should earn its place.
A headline should communicate something important.
A button should provide a meaningful next step.
A photograph should establish context or feeling.
A technical feature should solve a real problem.
Nothing exists merely because it can.
That is the discipline behind Summit Precision Design:
thoughtful reduction without sacrificing capability.
START WITH THE PROBLEM
What are you trying
to accomplish?
Tell me what you're building, who it's for,
and where you're getting stuck.
